mike: FYI — saw a p99 latency spike on prod after today's release. p99 generation for long-context models jumped from ~120ms to ~220ms. Suspect tokenizer + kernel routing change.

sasha: looking at traces now. KV cache miss rate up ~3x for checkpoint v2.3. tokenizer emits extra token in some sequences (counts increased). could explain cache key shift.

raj: ran profiler locally. kernel chosen switched fast_attn_v2 -> fallback_matmul for seq_len>512 because shape was tagged as ragged. batching heuristic started grouping longer sequences together, raising mem pressure.

alana: PR #4125 touched kernel selection policy and tokenizer manifest mapping. rolling change landed in today's merge.

mike: bisecting now, will post suspect commit. deploy-bot reports increased canary latency + error rate.

perf-ci: CI perf test failed: perf/regression/p99_generation > threshold on staging (build 2026-03-18-78). artifacts: https://ci/internal/artifacts/2026-03-18-78

raj: I can reproduce with checkpoint v2.3 + tokenizer config (add_bos=true). forcing kernel override to fast_attn_v2 restores baseline. temporary routing hint works as stopgap.

sasha: could be KV cache thrash — tokenizer changes shift token offsets so cache keys don't match, causing cold cache churn.

alana: confirmed config drift: model manifest v2.3 dropped 'normalize=true' and changed 'add_bos'. opening rollback PR for tokenizer config and a revert for kernel-selection tweak.

mike: priority = hotfix rollback tokenizer config + revert kernel selection commit. coordinating rollback with infra, tagging @oncall. :thumbsup:

raj: adding a regression test in runtime tests: synthetic seq-mix based on new tokenizer to surface kernel routing changes before merge.

mike: thanks — keep updates here. if we need a patch release we'll cut one after rollback verification.

// quick repro

raj: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"checkpoint-v2.3","input":"<long context>"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

alana: note: watch memory headroom during canary, fallback_matmul spikes allocs.

mike: ok, action items: 1) rollback tokenizer config (alana) 2) revert kernel selection change (mike) 3) add regression test (raj) 4) verify staging perf (sasha). I'll update timeline in #eng-releases.

mike: any objections? :thumbsup:
